name: BankAliases
technicalDescription: Maps a payer name as it appears on bank lines to a customer (rung 2 of payer identification). Since Iteration 9 an alias is written already approved when a person approves a match whose payer name differs from the customer name (source), and is not yet synced to Priority.

columns.name: bankName
columns.description: Payer name exactly as it appears on the bank line

columns.name: proposedFromBankLineId
columns.description: Bank line that triggered the proposal (text link to BankLines.bankLineId)

columns.name: approvedBy
columns.description: Who approved or rejected the alias

columns.name: approvedAt
columns.description: When the alias was approved or rejected

columns.name: isTestFixture
columns.description: True for marked test data; DeleteTestFixtures removes these rows. Writers always set it (no defaults).

columns.name: evidenceEmailId
columns.description: InboundEmails id that identified the payer, when it came from mail
